items.title: Charles Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997
items.q: Baritone Retinue. Well that was started with Pat Patrick and myself. This was years ago. But actually it was continuence of playing with Sun Ra because both of us used to play baritone with Sun Ra.

ctx.x: Tell me about the baritone sextet.

Baritone Retinue. Well that was started with Pat Patrick and myself. This was years ago. But actually it was continuence of playing with Sun Ra because both of us used to play baritone with Sun Ra. In fact we recorded with two baritones with Sun Ra.
Did he write out, how much of his music was actually written out, like big band charts, was it a lot of it?
